description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EA%B3%84%EB%8B%A8/2713), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/61929939)

**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/147756)

Mysterious staircase is known as a game exhibition in Gyeonggi-do. An old man who climbed there got sick made this stairs viral to the world. But after that old man's death, the main character Hyung-joo's father is caught up in a medical lawsuit. So Hyung-joo trys to undo her father's injustice. She will enter the Stairs Research Association, with the students who agree to be there.
